## Sources (how this label entered the ledger)
- **OBJECT-INDEX**, batch B0033, scope THEORY-LEVEL: Proposes what the document calls its most important discovery: the central mathematical object of KnowledgeOS may not be Knowledge itself but 'JustifiedStateTransition' -- the system preserves the whole trajectory KS_0-W0->KS_1-W1->KS_2->... rather than merely storing the latest state KS_n, said to fit remarkably well with the DDD/statistics/deterministic-assurance/Gita-Chapters-1-4 findings so far. Writes a first candidate 'provisional mathematical constitution' of ten axioms M1-M10: M1 Identity (every assertion has an identifiable subject/context, exists I(p)); M2 Temporality (T(p)!=empty); M3 Provenance (Promote(p) => P(p)!=empty); M4 Epistemic separation (Inference(p)!=Fact(p)); M5 Historical preservation (past assertions not rewritten by current knowledge); M6 Conflict preservation (Conflict(p) must remain representable); M7 Transition witness (KS_i->KS_j => Witness_ij); M8 Authority separation (Permission!=Authority); M9 Probabilistic separation (P(H|E)!=HistoricalFact(H)); M10 Deterministic admission (a transition is admitted only when declared invariants are satisfied) -- explicitly candidate invariants, not yet final constitutional rules.
